mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS has declined for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 5.0% indicates deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts and retail sales (HOUST and RSAFS) signals strong consumer demand and economic expansion, which drives corporate revenue growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS rise by more than 1% in the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where FEDFUNDS exceeds 4.5%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index (INDPRO) indicates robust manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO rises for 3 consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A housing starts level above 1200 thousand units signals strong residential construction activity, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods where HOUST exceeds 1200, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 95 (index 2017=100) indicates weakening manufacturing output, which typically leads to lower corporate profits and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where INDPRO falls below 95, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a high unemployment regime (UNRATE > 5.0% and rising), labor market weakness suppresses consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods where UNRATE > 5.0% and UNRATE has increased by more than 0.2 percentage points in the prior month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
